title: nan
key_contribution: Presents an EKF-based self-localization method for tethered drones in GPS-denied environments using motor PWM, accelerometer, gyroscope, and altimeter data without a cable force sensor, validated in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
